name: Trashcore
summary: This page is about the videogame aesthetic that often mixes oversaturated colours and crude artstyles with unrealistic horror and gore.
description:
This page is about the videogame aesthetic that often mixes oversaturated colours and crude artstyles with unrealistic horror and gore. For the aesthetic relating to urban pollution and technological decay, see Trashcore .

Trashcore is an aesthetic that describes videogames with a particularly harsh or bizarre visual style, palette or story that is designed to make the player feel uncomfortable, confused or out of their depth. Some Trashcore games use these aspects and this term together, though many games are also labelled as Trashcore due to their creators deeming them to be literally or figuratively trash, and many games are fall under the Trashcore aesthetic without being labled as such by their creators.

Games that have the Trashcore aesthetic tend to contain violent, sexual and/or shocking language and imagery that ranges from completely unserious and silly to unnecessarily detailed and vulgar. This content is not required for a game to be Trashcore, though it is content that many trashcore games have.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Discomfort, absurdism, confusion, violence, chaos
